label: Description title
summary: Going by its name, the title shown above the description of a kind of task contract (a job a character can take on).
details: Vanilla never names it on this type directly; the task contract window shows TaskContract.GetType.GetDescriptionTitle as a heading text, which is only a hint that this is the same function. It returns text.

label: Contract type icon
summary: Going by its name, the icon of a kind of task contract.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. GetIcon on other types (such as Dlc.GetIcon) is used as a picture's texture; that is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Contract type name
summary: The name of a kind of task contract (a job a character can take on), as text.
details: Vanilla uses it as the heading line of two texts about a contract, followed by a line naming the contractor and a line about the contract's tier.

label: Contract type as script scope
summary: The kind of task contract turned into a script scope, so that script-side functions can be used on it.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. On other types it is written like GetPlayer.MakeScope.ScriptValue('...') to read a script value; that is only a hint for how it works here.

label: Contract type itself
summary: Going by its name, the kind of task contract itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the task contract window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the task contract window (the window that shows one task contract).
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close button, and also right after the accept and the invalidate buttons, so the window shuts after those buttons are used.

label: Accept button text
summary: The text written on the task contract window's accept button.
details: Vanilla shows it on the big main button, which is visible only while the contract is neither started nor being travelled to.

label: Shown task contract
summary: The task contract the window currently shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data for the window's contents and to check whether the contract has failure conditions (ways the job can fail). The game documents no return type.

label: Invalidate tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the task contract window's button that invalidates (cancels) the contract.
details: Vanilla puts it on the button that opens the confirmation popup for invalidating the contract.

label: Accept tooltip
summary: The tooltip text of the task contract window's accept button.
details: Vanilla shows it while the button can be pressed; when it cannot, the button shows why the accept command is not allowed instead.

label: Is contract started
summary: Whether the contract shown in the task contract window has already been started.
details: Vanilla shows one part of the window only when it is true, and hides the accept button while the contract is started or the adventurer is travelling for it.

label: Is travelling for contract
summary: Going by its name, whether travel because of the contract shown in the task contract window is under way.
details: Vanilla hides the accept button while this is true or the contract has started. The game does not say whose travel it means.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the task contract window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Start contract
summary: Starts the contract shown in the task contract window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the accept button, which can only be pressed when the accept command for the contract is allowed; the window then closes.

label: Access change itself
summary: A function on a tax collector value change that, going by its name, hands back the value change itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Value breakdown
summary: The breakdown (the list of parts that add up to a total) of one value that changes when a tax collector is appointed.
details: Vanilla uses it in the appoint tax collector window for three values: the taxpayer limit, the tax and the levies. The text then shows the new value and, when it differs, how far it is from the value under the current collector. The game documents no return type.

label: Value with current collector
summary: The value (taxpayer limit, tax or levies) as it is with the current tax collector, as a number.
details: Vanilla subtracts it from the value being shown to display the difference, and shows that difference only when the two are not equal.

label: Value with no collector
summary: Going by its name, the value (such as tax or levies) as it would be with no tax collector at all, as a number.
details: Vanilla never uses it. The game documents nothing more.

label: Change itself
summary: A function on a tax collector value change that, going by its name, hands back the value change itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access jurisdiction itself
summary: A function on a tax jurisdiction that, going by its name, hands back the jurisdiction itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax decree off cooldown
summary: Going by its name and its use, whether the tax jurisdiction's tax decree is free of its cooldown.
details: The manage tax jurisdictions window shows an alert icon when this is false, with the cooldown description as its tooltip. That line reaches the jurisdiction through TaxSlotItem.GetTaxSlot; what true and false mean is read from that use.

label: Custom text
summary: Going by its name, text from a custom localization (a scripted text with entries chosen by conditions), produced for the tax jurisdiction.
details: It takes one argument, the custom text's key. Vanilla never names it on this type; on characters it is written like Character.Custom( 'AIEconomicPersonality' ), which is only a hint.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The key of the custom localization.

label: Jurisdiction ID
summary: The tax jurisdiction's ID number.
details: Vanilla passes it to ToggleGameViewData to open or close the tax decrees view of that jurisdiction.

label: Jurisdiction name
summary: The name of the tax jurisdiction (a group of the ruler's vassals whose taxes one tax collector gathers), as text.
details: Vanilla uses it in headings such as the tax decrees window's title and when a jurisdiction already has as many taxpayers as it can take.

label: Tax decree
summary: The tax decree (the rule the tax collector enforces on the jurisdiction's taxpayers) the tax jurisdiction currently has.
details: Vanilla shows its name on the button that opens the tax decrees and in the realm window's line about what goes to the liege. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax decree cooldown text
summary: Going by its name and its use, the text that describes the cooldown on changing the tax jurisdiction's tax decree.
details: The manage tax jurisdictions window shows it as the tooltip of the alert icon that appears while the decree is on cooldown. That line reaches the jurisdiction through TaxSlotItem.GetTaxSlot.

label: Firing consequences text
summary: The text that tells what happens when the tax jurisdiction's tax collector is fired or replaced.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tooltips of the Fire and Replace buttons and in the confirmation popups for firing or replacing the collector.

label: Jurisdiction owner
summary: Going by its name, the character who owns the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data for the tax decrees window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax collector
summary: The tax collector of the tax jurisdiction (the character who gathers its taxes).
details: Vanilla shows the collector's name, for example in the line about the liege's tax collector and in the text saying who enforces the tax decree. The game documents no return type.

label: Jurisdiction type
summary: The type of the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it to show a character's aptitude (how well suited they are) as tax collector for this jurisdiction, and as data in the appoint tax collector window. The game documents no return type.

label: Taxpayer count
summary: How many vassals the tax jurisdiction currently taxes (its taxpayers), as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it next to the jurisdiction's vassal limit, as in 3/5.

label: Taxpayer limit
summary: The most vassals the tax jurisdiction can tax, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it after the current number of taxpayers, and in the message that a jurisdiction is already full.

label: Taxpayer limit text
summary: The text that explains the tax jurisdiction's taxpayer limit.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip on the taxpayers count.

label: Has default tax decree
summary: Going by its name, whether the tax jurisdiction has the default tax decree.
details: It takes one argument, which the game does not describe. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Has tax collector
summary: Going by its name, whether the tax jurisdiction has a tax collector.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. The appoint tax collector window has a function of the same name to choose between Appoint and Replace headings; that is only a hint.

label: Has taxpayers
summary: Whether the tax jurisdiction has any taxpayers (vassals it taxes).
details: Vanilla uses it when the jurisdiction's vassal window opens: with taxpayers it starts on the manage vassals tab, without them on the assign vassals tab.

label: Is empty
summary: Going by its name, whether the tax jurisdiction is empty.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type, and the name does not say whether it means no collector or no taxpayers. IsEmpty on inventory slots is only a hint.

label: Jurisdiction itself
summary: The tax jurisdiction itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the assign vassal window to check whether the jurisdiction can be chosen and to get the tooltip that says why not. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the assign vassal to tax jurisdiction window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Assign vassal
summary: Assigns the vassal to the tax jurisdiction chosen in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's confirm button, which can be pressed only once a jurisdiction is selected.

label: Can choose jurisdiction
summary: Whether the given tax jurisdiction can be chosen for the vassal in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it to enable or disable each jurisdiction's entry in the list.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax jurisdiction, such as TaxSlot.Self

label: Close window
summary: Closes the window for assigning a vassal to a tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close buttons, and also right after the assign button.

label: Current jurisdiction
summary: Going by its name, the tax jurisdiction the vassal is assigned to now, as an entry of the jurisdictions list.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data for parts of the assign vassal window. It returns a tax jurisdiction list entry.

label: Why jurisdiction can't be chosen
summary: The text that tells whether, or why not, the given tax jurisdiction can be chosen for the vassal.
details: Vanilla shows it as the tooltip of each jurisdiction's entry in the assign vassal window.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax jurisdiction, such as TaxSlot.Self

label: Liege
summary: The liege the assign vassal window is about, as a character.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data for parts of the window.

label: Tax jurisdiction
summary: The list of tax jurisdictions shown in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla fills the window's list with it and shows a separate message when it is empty. The game documents no return type.

label: Total levy breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the total levies (troops raised from vassals) in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Total tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the total tax in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassal
summary: The vassal the assign vassal window is about, as a character.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data for parts of the window.

label: Vassal levy breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the levies the vassal in the assign vassal window provides.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassal tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the tax the vassal in the assign vassal window pays.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Has current jurisdiction
summary: Going by its name, whether the vassal in the assign vassal window is already assigned to a tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Has chosen jurisdiction
summary: Whether a tax jurisdiction is selected in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla switches parts of the window on it and enables the confirm button only when it is true.

label: Is jurisdiction chosen
summary: Whether the given tax jurisdiction is the one selected in the assign vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it to show that jurisdiction's entry as pressed down.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The jurisdiction list entry to check.
fields.values: a tax jurisdiction entry, such as TaxSlotItem.Self

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the assign vassal to tax jurisdiction window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Choose jurisdiction
summary: Selects the given tax jurisdiction in the assign vassal window, or unselects it when it is already selected.
details: Vanilla calls it when an entry of the jurisdictions list is clicked. What toggling means is read from the name.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax jurisdiction entry, such as TaxSlotItem.Self

label: Access entry itself
summary: The tax jurisdiction list entry itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the manage tax jurisdictions window's RemoveTaxCollector when a button is clicked. The game documents no return type.

label: Levy breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the levies (troops) that come from the tax jurisdiction in a list entry.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of texts in the manage tax jurisdictions window and the assign vassal window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the tax that comes from the tax jurisdiction in a list entry.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of texts in the manage tax jurisdictions window and the assign vassal window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax collector
summary: The tax collector of the tax jurisdiction in a list entry.
details: Vanilla shows the collector's name in the tooltips of the Fire and Replace buttons and uses the collector as data in the manage tax jurisdictions window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax jurisdiction
summary: The tax jurisdiction a list entry stands for.
details: Vanilla uses it to reach the jurisdiction's own functions, such as the text on what firing its collector does. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassal
summary: The vassals of the tax jurisdiction in a list entry.
details: Vanilla checks whether this list has items to choose what a jurisdiction without a collector shows. The game documents no return type.

label: Has tax collector
summary: Whether the tax jurisdiction in a list entry has a tax collector.
details: Vanilla shows different parts of the manage tax jurisdictions window depending on it, and on whether the jurisdiction has vassals.

label: Entry itself
summary: The tax jurisdiction list entry itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the assign vassal window to select the entry and to check whether it is selected. The game documents no return type.

label: Access decree itself
summary: A function on a tax decree that, going by its name, hands back the decree itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Decree effects text
summary: The text that lists what a tax decree does.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tax decrees window and in the decree's tooltip.

label: Decree flavor text
summary: The descriptive (flavor) text of a tax decree.
details: Vanilla shows it in the decree's tooltip and for the selected decree in the tax decrees window.

label: Decree icon
summary: The icon of a tax decree.
details: Vanilla uses it as a picture in the tax decrees window, the assign vassal window and the decree's tooltip. The game documents no return type.

label: Decree name
summary: The name of a tax decree, as text.
details: Vanilla reaches it through other functions, such as TaxSlot.GetObligation.GetName for the decree a jurisdiction has.

label: Decree name, no tooltip
summary: The name of a tax decree as text, without the tooltip that the name otherwise carries.
details: Vanilla uses it in the tax decrees window and inside the decree's own tooltip.

label: Has icon
summary: Going by its name, whether the tax decree has an icon.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; HasIcon on other types (such as laws) hides an icon that does not exist, which is only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Decree itself
summary: The tax decree itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the tax decrees window to check whether the decree can be chosen, to get the warning texts, and to select it. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the tax decrees window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Apply decree change
summary: Applies the tax decree chosen in the tax decrees window to the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's confirm button, which is enabled only when the change can be applied.

label: Can apply decree change
summary: Whether the tax decree change chosen in the tax decrees window can be applied.
details: Vanilla enables the confirm button only when it is true.

label: Can choose decree
summary: Whether the given tax decree can be chosen in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla enables or disables each decree's button with it.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax decree, such as TaxSlotObligation.Self

label: Why decree can't be chosen
summary: The text that says why the given tax decree cannot be chosen in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla joins it with the text on vassals that do not fit the decree in the decree's warning tooltip.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax decree, such as TaxSlotObligation.Self

label: Can view decree
summary: Going by its name, whether the given tax decree may be shown in the tax decrees window.
details: It takes one argument, presumably the decree. Vanilla never uses it.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close button, and also right after the confirm button that applies the change.

label: Current levy breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the jurisdiction's levies under its current tax decree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the tax decrees window, next to the preview for the chosen decree. The game documents no return type.

label: Current tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the jurisdiction's tax under its current tax decree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the tax decrees window, next to the preview for the chosen decree. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassals unfit for decree
summary: Going by its name and its use, the text about vassals of the jurisdiction for whom the given tax decree is not valid.
details: Vanilla joins it with the text on why the decree cannot be chosen in the decree's warning tooltip.

label: Tax decree
summary: The list of tax decrees shown in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla fills the window's list of decrees with it. The game documents no return type.

label: Preview levy breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the jurisdiction's levies as they would be under the chosen tax decree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the tax decrees window. The game documents no return type.

label: Preview tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the jurisdiction's tax as it would be under the chosen tax decree.
details: Vanilla uses it as the data of one text in the tax decrees window. The game documents no return type.

label: Chosen decree
summary: The tax decree currently selected in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla shows its name after 'Selected:' and its flavor text in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax jurisdiction
summary: The tax jurisdiction whose decrees the tax decrees window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it to show the jurisdiction's current decree after 'Current:'.

label: Has decree change
summary: Whether a different tax decree than the current one is chosen in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla shows some parts of the window only when it is true and others only when it is false. That it means a pending change is read from the name.

label: Choose decree
summary: Selects the given tax decree in the tax decrees window.
details: Vanilla calls it when a decree's button is clicked.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.values: a tax decree, such as TaxSlotObligation.Self

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the tax decrees window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access type itself
summary: A function on a tax jurisdiction type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Jurisdiction type name
summary: The name of a tax jurisdiction type, as text.
details: Vanilla builds a jurisdiction's name from it: the collector's first name in the possessive (or Empty when there is none), then this name.

label: Collector aptitude text
summary: The text that says how good the given character would be as tax collector for this jurisdiction type (their aptitude).
details: Vanilla shows it next to the word aptitude in the appoint tax collector window and in a line of the assign vassal view.

label: Collector aptitude tooltip
summary: Going by its name, the tooltip that explains the given character's aptitude as tax collector for this jurisdiction type.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the appoint tax collector window. The game documents no return type.

label: Type itself
summary: A function on a tax jurisdiction type that, going by its name, hands back the type itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access change itself
summary: A function on a tax jurisdiction vassal change that, going by its name, hands back the change itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Levies breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the levies after vassals are added to or removed from a tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the jurisdiction's vassal window, where the text shows the value and the change. The game documents no return type.

label: Levies change
summary: How much the levies change when vassals are added to a tax jurisdiction, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla shows it with a plus or minus sign after the new value; for removing vassals it shows the negated number.

label: Tax breakdown
summary: Going by its name, the breakdown of the tax after vassals are added to or removed from a tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the jurisdiction's vassal window, where the text shows the value and the change. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax change
summary: How much the tax changes when vassals are added to a tax jurisdiction, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it with two decimals and a sign after the new value; for removing vassals it shows the negated number.

label: Change itself
summary: A function on a tax jurisdiction vassal change that, going by its name, hands back the change itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Assigned vassals list
summary: Going by its name, the list of vassals already assigned to the tax jurisdiction in its vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window's manage vassals part. The game documents no return type.

label: Assigned vassals base list
summary: Going by its name, the underlying list of the vassals already assigned to the tax jurisdiction in its vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window, next to AccessAssignedVassals; how the two differ is not documented. The game documents no return type.

label: Access window itself
summary: A function on the tax jurisdiction vassal window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Unassigned vassals list
summary: Going by its name, the list of vassals not yet assigned to the tax jurisdiction, in its vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window's assign vassals part. The game documents no return type.

label: Unassigned vassals base list
summary: Going by its name, the underlying list of the vassals not yet assigned to the tax jurisdiction, in its vassal window.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window, next to AccessUnassignedVassals; how the two differ is not documented. The game documents no return type.

label: Assign vassals
summary: Assigns the vassals chosen in the vassal window to the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in the window.

label: Close window
summary: Closes the tax jurisdiction vassal window.
details: Vanilla calls it from the window's close button.

label: Changes when assigning
summary: Going by its name, how tax and levies would change if the chosen vassals were assigned to the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the vassal window. The game documents no return type.

label: Liege
summary: Going by its name, the liege whose tax jurisdiction the vassal window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Changes when removing
summary: Going by its name, how tax and levies would change if the chosen vassals were removed from the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the vassal window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tax jurisdiction
summary: The tax jurisdiction whose vassals the vassal window shows.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the window. The game documents no return type.

label: Vassal's jurisdiction status
summary: Going by its name and its use, a text that says how the given character stands with tax jurisdictions, shown in their row of the vassal window.
details: Vanilla passes the character of each list row.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character of the list row.

label: Remove vassals
summary: Removes the vassals chosen in the vassal window from the tax jurisdiction.
details: Vanilla calls it from a button in the window.

label: Window itself
summary: A function on the tax jurisdiction vassal window that, going by its name, hands back the window itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access group itself
summary: A function on a tenet group entry that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Tenet
summary: Going by its name, the tenets (core beliefs of a faith) in a tenet group entry.
details: Vanilla never uses it; GetTenets is the one vanilla uses for the list. The game documents no return type.

label: Can pick from group
summary: Going by its name and its use, whether a tenet can be picked from this tenet group.
details: In the personal beliefs window the group is shown when this is true, or when no personal tenet is being added or swapped.

label: Group title
summary: The heading of a tenet group, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the faith window, the personal beliefs window and the window for creating a rite.

label: Tenet
summary: The tenets (core beliefs of a faith) in a tenet group.
details: Vanilla fills the group's list with it in the faith window and the personal beliefs window. The game documents no return type.

label: Group itself
summary: A function on a tenet group entry that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tenet itself
summary: A function on a tenet entry that, going by its name, hands back the entry itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Can pick tenet
summary: Whether the tenet can be picked, given two arguments.
details: Vanilla uses it in the rite creation window to enable a tenet's button, passing the rite's founder and the window's top data. What the second argument stands for is not documented.

fields.name: Arg0
fields.text: The character picking, in vanilla the rite's founder.

label: Tenet divergence
summary: The rite divergence value tied to the tenet, as a number.
details: Vanilla shows it with the divergence icon in the rite creation window.

label: Faith
summary: The faith the tenet entry belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the faith window. The game documents no return type.

label: Tenet icon
summary: The icon of the tenet.
details: Vanilla uses it as a picture in the faith window and the personal beliefs window. The game documents no return type.

label: Entry ID
summary: An ID text for the tenet entry.
details: Vanilla uses it as the key of an interface variable that the activity planner's tenet selection toggles, clears and checks.

label: Rite
summary: The rite the tenet entry belongs to.
details: Vanilla uses it as data in the faith window. The game documents no return type.

label: Slot number
summary: The number of the slot the tenet sits in, as a whole number.
details: Vanilla uses it in the rite creation window to open the sorted list of choices for that slot and to mark the slot being edited.

label: Current fulfillment
summary: The character's current spiritual fulfillment for the personal tenet, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it on the personal tenet banner and in the tooltip of the swap button.

label: Fulfillment change on rejecting
summary: How the character's spiritual fulfillment changes when they reject this personal tenet, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the tooltip of the reject button in the personal beliefs window.

label: Fulfillment value
summary: Going by its name, the spiritual fulfillment value of the personal tenet, as a number.
details: Vanilla never uses it.

label: Tenet
summary: The tenet an entry stands for.
details: Vanilla shows its name, worded for the character's rite, in the spiritual fulfillment change breakdowns for adopting, rejecting and swapping. The game documents no return type.

label: Is empty
summary: Whether the tenet entry is empty, that is holds no tenet.
details: Vanilla shows the tenet's parts only when this is false.

label: Is personal tenet
summary: Whether the tenet is one of the character's personal tenets.
details: Vanilla uses it in the personal beliefs window's footers to offer adding or swapping only a tenet that is not already personal.

label: Is prohibited
summary: Whether the tenet entry is marked as prohibited.
details: Vanilla shows parts of the entry only when it is true, in the activity planner's tenet selection.

label: Tenet itself
summary: The tenet entry itself, for passing it on to another function.
details: Vanilla passes it to the rite creation window to select the tenet. The game documents no return type.

label: Should show
summary: Going by its name, whether the tenet entry should be shown, given one argument.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. DoctrineItem.ShouldDisplay( TopScope.Self ) in the rite creation window is only a hint.

label: Access sorter itself
summary: A function on the tenet sorter that, going by its name, hands back the sorter itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Sort option
summary: The options by which a tenet list can be sorted.
details: Vanilla fills the sort dropdown with it. The game documents no return type.

label: Selected sort option
summary: Which sort option of the tenet list is selected.
details: Vanilla uses it for the sort dropdown's selected entry. It returns a pair of whole numbers.

label: Sort order
summary: Whether the tenet list is sorted in ascending order (true) or descending (false).
details: Vanilla shows Ascending or Descending in the sort button's tooltip and picks the button's picture from it.

label: Sort option changed
summary: Updates the tenet list's sorting when another sort option is chosen.
details: Vanilla calls it when the sort dropdown's selection changes.

label: Flip sort order
summary: Switches the tenet list between ascending and descending order.
details: Vanilla calls it from the sort order button.

label: Sorter itself
summary: A function on the tenet sorter that, going by its name, hands back the sorter itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access option itself
summary: A function on a tenet sort option that, going by its name, hands back the option itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Sort option name
summary: The name of a tenet sort option, as text.
details: Vanilla shows it in the sort dropdown.

label: Option itself
summary: A function on a tenet sort option that, going by its name, hands back the option itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type. Self appears often after other types (for example Character.Self passed as an argument); those lines are only a hint. The game documents no return type.

label: Access tenet itself
summary: A function on a tenet type that, going by its name, hands back the tenet itself.
details: Vanilla never names it on this type; PdxGuiWidget.AccessSelf is a different type and only a hint. The game documents no return type.
